items.title: Sheryl Bailey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 24, 2023
items.q: I always would say, you know I think it was Ornette said it, it was like there’s no such thing as bad music there’s bad musicians.

ctx.x: Nice. Do you ever find yourself sitting in and you know, just playing some Rolling Stones?

Sure. I love all that stuff. Count me in. I always would say, you know I think it was Ornette said it, it was like there’s no such thing as bad music there’s bad musicians. You © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
know what I mean? Like yeah, if some cats are playing and want to play, you know, “Can’t Get No Satisfaction” that’s going to be grooving.
